newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan Hua Nan Bank cuts prime rate.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan Hua Nan Bank cuts prime rate.

text.p: Hua Nan Commercial Bank, one of Taiwan's Big Three state-run banks, said on Tuesday it would cut its prime lending rate by 0.05 percentage points to 7.55 percent from 7.60, effective on Wednesday.
"To cope with the current loose liquidity, we decided to cut our prime lending rate by 0.05 percentage points to 7.55 percent, effective from Wednesday," the bank said in a statement.
It also would cut most of its one-month-to-three-year time deposit rates by 0.10 percentage points, it said.

This followed an announcement earlier on Tuesday by First Commercial Bank, another of Taiwan's Big Three banks, that it was cutting its prime lending rate by 0.05 percentage points to 7.55 effective Tuesday.
